# Småbolagsförvaltaren självkritik: "Jag får äta upp det"

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-09-02  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

A Swedish small-cap fund manager admits his call for a 2026 small-cap rally has not played out yet, since the small-cap index is still well below its highs. He still expects a strong autumn because Q1 and Q2 small-cap earnings beat large caps, analysts are revising estimates upward and relative valuations are at a 20-year low. He sees a risk in richly valued AI-infrastructure and industrial stocks. He describes a rotation since 24 July out of semiconductors into beaten-down software and smaller companies, and names Lime Technologies as a cheap, growing software holding.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 LIME — Lime Technologies | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest fund manager holds it. Organic growth sped up from 9% to 12%, customer count is at a record and the stock trades at ~14x 12-month earnings despite the SaaS turnaround.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (small-cap fund manager, owns the stock). Lime was sold down on fears that AI would displace SaaS, but results contradict that: organic growth rose from 9% in Q1 to 12% in Q2, customer count is at a record and it sells its own AI products. At ~14x forward earnings with 12% organic growth the valuation looks low. A market-wide rotation from semiconductors into software since late July could re-rate it further, though the stock has already risen somewhat.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth slows below Q2 level
- if customer churn rises due to AI substitution
- if rates rise and pressure small-cap growth valuations
- if the software rotation reverses

> *"Jag tror att Lime ligger på att värderas 14 gånger på 12 månader. Det får betraktas som väldigt lågt om det växer organiskt 12 %. Så det finns god potential till att det här kan fortsätta vända runt."*
